# Mathematics of Artificial Intelligence

**From first principles to the latest theories — a sequenced academic reference**

Fifty-four chapters in nine parts: logic and sets, linear algebra and matrix calculus, probability and optimization, information theory and statistical learning, neural networks and signal processing, with LaTeX derivations, vector figures and proofs.

![Mathematics of Artificial Intelligence](books/mathematics-for-ai/cover.png)

## What you will learn

- **Foundations** — 6 chapters & appendices
- **Calculus and Matrix Analysis** — 6 chapters & appendices
- **Probability and Statistics** — 7 chapters & appendices
- **Optimization** — 6 chapters & appendices
- **Information Theory** — 4 chapters & appendices
- **Statistical Learning** — 5 chapters & appendices
- **Neural Networks** — 8 chapters & appendices
- **Advanced Structures** — 6 chapters & appendices
- **Sequences and Signals** — 6 chapters & appendices
